candidates.name: american residential services
candidates.description: american residential services (ars®/rescue rooter®) is one of the nation’s largest providers of heating, air conditioning, indoor air quality, plumbing, drain cleaning, electrical, and sewer services for residential and light commercial customers, operating through a nationwide network of company-owned locations.formed in 1980, ars grew by bringing together trusted local and regional service companies and later joined with rescue rooter, a plumbing brand founded in 1975, under shared ownership by servicemaster in the late 1990s. today, ars/rescue rooter is headquartered in memphis, tennessee, with locations across 24 states and washington, dc, delivering essential services to homes and businesses nationwide.ars/rescue rooter is known for its focus on reliable service, skilled professionals, and consistent standards across its network. specialists and comfort advisors receive ongoing training and background screening, and all work is supported by the company’s exceptional service guarantee, which reflects a commitment to addressing customer concerns and maintaining high service standards. if customers are dissatisfied, the company works to resolve issues and make things right.ars/rescue rooter continues to grow by partnering with and acquiring well-regarded home service providers and working closely with leading suppliers and retailers. in 2020, gi partners made a majority investment in ars, alongside existing investor charlesbank capital partners and company management, to support continued growth, innovation, and long-term improvements in customer experience.community servicears/rescue rooter supports communities through its company-wide ars cares initiative, which provides free hvac systems and water heaters to selected community heroes. the company also supports organizations such as st. jude children’s research hospital and the tim tebow foundation’s night to shine, and contributes to a range of local charities across its operating locations.
candidates.rationale: Both are nationwide home-service providers offering plumbing, drain cleaning, and sewer services to residential and light-commercial customers.

candidates.name: benjamin franklin plumbing, llc
candidates.description: benjamin franklin plumbing was founded on a simple premise—always be on time. as “the punctual plumbers,” customers know that they can count on us to always be on time and complete the work to their satisfaction. this established trust has allowed us to become a top plumbing franchise.with benjamin franklin plumbing, you are set up for success from the beginning. all our franchisees have access to the following:unlimited training and business coachingintegrated business management systemsmarketing and advertising strategies to generate more sales leadswhether you’re just starting out or looking to grow your business, becoming a part of benjamin franklin plumbing means you are in business for yourself, but you’re never by yourself.  we allow you to do so much more for your customers, your employees and yourself.contact us today to discuss a plan that will work for your business!
candidates.rationale: Both are national plumbing and drain-service franchise networks serving residential customers with substantially overlapping home-service offerings.

candidates.name: chemed corporation
candidates.description: chemed is a holding company.  our wholly owned subsidiaries are vitas and roto-rooter services company.  vitas is a healthcare company that specializes in hospice or end of life care for the terminally ill.  roto-rooter is the nation's largest provider of plumbing and drain care services.
candidates.rationale: Chemed is Roto-Rooter’s parent holding company, not a separate plumbing or home-services operator to prospect as a lookalike.

candidates.name: cintas
candidates.description: cintas corporation, a fortune 500 company headquartered in cincinnati, specializes in helping businesses of all sizes get ready™ for the workday®. we provide a comprehensive range of products and services, including uniforms, mats, mops, towels, restroom supplies, workplace water services, first aid and safety products, eye-wash stations, safety training, fire extinguishers, sprinkler systems and alarm service, ensuring that our clients' facilities and employees are clean, safe, and at their best. as a publicly traded company (ctas) listed on the nasdaq global select market, we are proud to contribute to the success of over one million businesses worldwide.about us: https://www.cintas.com/company/our careers & our culture: https://www.careers.cintas.com/?utm_source=linkedin&utm_medium=li-profileterms of use: https://www.cintas.com/tou
candidates.rationale: Cintas provides workplace uniforms and facility services, not consumer plumbing, drain cleaning, or water-remediation services for the same job to be done.

candidates.name: goettl air conditioning & plumbing
candidates.description: at goettl, our mission is to "goettlize the nation" by setting the industry standard in hvac and plumbing services. we equip every technician and employee with best-in-class training and technology, empowering our team to deliver exceptional customer service in each of our markets: las vegas, reno, phoenix, tucson, san antonio, and austin. our rapid expansion reflects our success and commitment to excellence.founded in 1939, goettl air conditioning and plumbing provides a comprehensive range of heating, cooling, and plumbing solutions. we offer high-quality hvac equipment and expert maintenance, repair, and replacement services to keep homes safe, comfortable, and efficient.at goettl, we believe that outstanding customer service begins with outstanding employees. if you're interested in joining our fast-growing team, visit goettl careers (www.goettl.com/careers) to explore current opportunities.from optimizing air conditioning systems to enhancing indoor air quality, plumbing, and insulation, goettl delivers total home comfort solutions that bring peace of mind. with our commitment to doing things the right way—not the easy way—goettl is the trusted choice for homeowners seeking reliable and effective home services.join the thousands of residents who have relied on goettl since 1939 and experience world-class service.
candidates.rationale: Both provide residential plumbing and related home maintenance services to homeowners, with direct overlap in plumbing repair and service needs.

candidates.name: mr. rooter® plumbing
candidates.description: for consumer services visit https://www.mrrooter.com.to discover more about franchising opportunities in your area, visit www.mrrooterfranchise.com.established in 1970, mr. rooter is the second largest full-service plumbing and drain cleaning company in the u.s. recognized by entrepreneur magazine among its “franchise 500” and franchise times top 200, mr. rooter franchisees provide services to both residential and commercial customers at more than 200 locations in the united states and canada and more than 100 locations internationally through master licensees. mr. rooter began franchising in 1974 and is a subsidiary of the dwyer group. for more information or to find the location nearest you, please visit our website at https://www.mrrooter.com.
candidates.rationale: Both are franchised full-service plumbing and drain-cleaning providers serving residential and commercial customers for the same service needs.

candidates.name: service champions plumbing, heating & ac
candidates.description: service champions is the premier plumbing, heating and air conditioning company in southern california, serving residential homeowners in all of orange county, and parts of la county, san bernardino county, and riverside county. leland smith founded service champions heating and air conditioning in march of 2000. service champions'​ goal at the beginning of its existence, as it is today, is to provide homeowners in southern california a service that is beyond their expectations. service champions specializes in maintenance, repair, equipment sales and installation of all brands of heating and air conditioning systems. in addition, service champions are experts in indoor air quality systems, providing solutions for your family’s comfort and health.
candidates.rationale: Both provide residential plumbing and related home repair services to homeowners, with overlapping service needs and buyer personas.

candidates.name: service experts
candidates.description: service experts is north america's leading hvac, plumbing & electrical company with 75+ locations nationwide.
candidates.rationale: Both provide residential plumbing and related home services through large multi-location networks, targeting homeowners with overlapping repair needs.

candidates.name: vitas healthcare
candidates.description: the nation’s leading provider of end-of-life care, and we have the resources and expertise to support your personal and professional growth. with nearly 12,000 employees, vitas was named a 2025 top workplace in healthcare.  we are committed to providing compassionate care to hospice patients and supporting their families. vitas team members find fulfillment working for a people-focused organization dedicated to making a difference in the lives of others.we also take care of each other, supporting our team members with resources, mentoring, and flexibility to do what’s right at the bedside. here, you will be trusted as an expert in your field and as a valued team member whose efforts are vital to our mission. join the team at vitas and do work that matters: your passion. our purpose. endless possibilities.
candidates.rationale: VITAS provides hospice and end-of-life healthcare, not plumbing, drain cleaning, water remediation, or related home services.
